name: 2 Chronicles
tagline: The kings of Judah and the temple
author: Not named in the text. Tradition names Ezra.
setting: Tells the story of Solomon and the kings of Judah, ending with the exile and a call to return.
theme: When the king and people seek the Lord, they find him, and when they forsake him they fall.

outline.label: The temple cleansed and Passover kept
The last kings and the exile

christInBook: Solomon’s temple foreshadows the true temple, Christ himself. The book ends with Cyrus’s decree sending the exiles home, which points ahead to the greater return from exile that the prophets promised.
howToRead: The Chronicler emphasizes that when kings seek the LORD, they prosper, and when they forsake him, they fall. Watch the stress on repentance and revival, especially under Hezekiah and Josiah.
